registered: 2026-11-18 ~11:45 ET, before any SPY bar was joined to a trade or any trade scored for these rules
operator: 11/18: 'Yes, queue both' - (1) don't buy while SPY is falling; (2) entries bunched together fail together. Goal: avoid the trades that fall straight to the stop (running list row 142).

data.trades: broker round trips as tools/studies/flow_exit.load_trades (2026-09-16..11-18, desk-off 11/12-11/16 out, entries 09:31-15:45); days without SIP SPY minute bars in the warehouse are dropped
data.spy: SPY 1-minute closes from the SIP warehouse (relative_strength_scan.load_day, merges sip_hedge)

rules.MARKET_DROP: skip the buy if SPY's return from the close of minute m-6 to the close of minute m-1 (the 5 complete minutes before the entry minute m) <= -X bp; X in {5, 10, 15}
rules.BUNCHED: skip the buy if at least k other buys (other symbols) filled in the M minutes before it; (M, k) in {(2,1), (5,1), (5,2)}

scoring: a skipped trade contributes 0 instead of its broker return (delta = -ret); untouched trades 0. Freed slots are NOT refilled (conservative for opens, neutral for the per-trade bar).

split.train: entry day <= 2026-10-23: choose each rule's setting by book delta
split.test: entry day >= 2026-10-26: the chosen setting only, scored once

pass_if_ALL (test, each rule separately).both_halves: train book delta of the chosen setting > 0
pass_if_ALL (test, each rule separately).kept_quality: kept trades' mean net bp > all trades' mean net bp (the skip must raise profit per kept trade, not just trade less)

information: share of full stop-outs (<= -40 bp) among skipped vs kept
after_pass: build the passing rule(s) behind a switch (default off); under the operator's 11/18 rule a PASS ships (paper). Opens fall by the skipped share - reported alongside.
else: record; the straight-to-stop trades are not explained by market drops or bunching
caveats: fills span several desk configs; warehouse SPY is SIP, the live desk would read SPY from its own feed; no slot refill modelled
